svg.title: Hi-C map — 20×20 strong compartments
svg.desc: A symmetric 20-by-20 Hi-C matrix with edge-touching bins, genomic-distance decay, distance-attenuated compartment signal, symmetric per-entry noise from 0.95 to 1.05, and 1 mirrored domain-corner pair.
svg.metadata: Compartments: A4 B3 A5 B4 A4. Domain lengths: 4, 3, 5, 4, 4. Noise seed: 555. Bin rectangles have no stroke and share exact numeric boundaries.
